about.title: About Me
about.intro: Senior technical artist working on real-time rendering and engine development. I build the tools I need: a C++20 / DirectX 11 scene engine and editor, plus a set of technical-art helpers for Unreal Engine. Before that I did multimedia design for the National Centre for the Performing Arts, conceptual design for Baidu Xirang and the China Science Fiction Convention, and years of VFX compositing, editing and documentary directing. I now teach digital arts and digital technology, and co-authored two books on Unreal Engine development and virtual production.
